description: Adopt Flash TP4 dense prefill tail folds after the workspace reservation proof. Replace only the specified split-tail and 65-127-row general-fold launches with exact-row pieces of at most 64 rows. Arguments reuse the original weights, live-row and status pointers; exact sliced activation, scale, output and disjoint scratch spans bind to authenticated allocations. The status output remains the original status allocation. All full tiles and other operations remain exact.
